compiled_state.title: harvest-worktree.sh: exits 2 for docs-only commits (review-status not written when SKIP_REVIEW=true)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
harvest-worktree.sh line 191 unconditionally requires review-status in the worktree artifacts directory. However, when COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md detects SKIP_REVIEW=true (all changed files are in review-gate-allowlist.conf, e.g. docs/**), it skips the review pipeline and no review-status is written. This causes harvest to exit 2 ('review-status not found') for legitimate docs-only commits.

pre-commit-review-gate.sh correctly handles this: it checks if all staged files are allowlisted and exits 0 immediately without checking review-status. harvest-worktree.sh should apply the same logic.

Fix: in harvest-worktree.sh, before the review-status existence check, run skip-review-check.sh on the worktree's changed files (or check if tested_files=doc-only-exempt in test-gate-status). If SKIP_REVIEW=true, bypass the review-status gate (matching pre-commit-review-gate.sh behavior).

Workaround applied during sprint 3e74-56da T17a: ran a real review on the docs-only change to produce review-status, then re-harvested successfully.

comments.body: Intent Gate: intent-aligned (high confidence) — no design intent justifies unconditional review-status requirement when SKIP_REVIEW=true. Fix for test-gate-status doc-only exemption was incomplete, leaving review-status as the remaining blocker.
comments.author: Test

comments.body:
Investigation RESULT (BASIC):
ROOT_CAUSE: harvest-worktree.sh line 191 unconditionally requires review-status, but SKIP_REVIEW=true path (COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 0.5) never writes it.
FIX: Before line 191 check, classify worktree diff against review-gate-allowlist.conf via skip-review-check.sh; skip review-status gate when all files are allowlisted.
